title: Great private tour worth it!!

title: Seville magnificent!!!

title: Expertise, Story, Love of Sevilla
text: Laura was excellent! She was very knowledgeable about the history of Sevilla and she did an excellent job creating story lines over the course of the day. We spent most of the day with her in the Alcázar, the Catedral y Giralda, and the neighborhoods and finished up at the Plaza de España. Laura shared her love of Sevilla and her love of and expertise in art history. We strongly recommend her and expect that this is a standard for the firm.
author: DWrightGibson

title: We loved it!
text: Very entertaining, enriching and enjoyable. It gave us time to see a lot of things and without getting too tired. It adapts perfectly to your needs and is very attentive. Very nice walks and conversations. We loved it!
author: ainhoav123

title: LEARN ALL THE HISTORY WHILE YOU KNOW SEVILLE
text:
Thanks to Laura and her passion for history and art, my partner and I have re-discovered Seville. 
I wish at school they would explain the story like Laura did! We have travelled back many centuries, met Don Juan Tenorio, learned the war strategies of enemies and learned all the art styles that hold together in such important monuments as Seville Cathedral.
Traveling is not only about visiting the most important monuments and taking/taking pictures; it is about knowing, learning and soaking up each city.
THANKS TO PEOPLE LIKE LAURA, IT'S POSSIBLE! SUPER RECOMMENDED!
author: LidiaPT26
